description: The report records demonstrator-team assessment of key performance indicators and key design parameters across thermal-storage project phases. It explicitly distinguishes indicators assessed from operating data from parameters specified before construction, and compares evaluation practices across projects. It is a reference information source for consistent thermal-storage model assessment; native metadata does not establish that measured KPI series, thresholds or an executable are released. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
